 Prime Video 's best new action thriller, which scored big upon release, just reached a massive milestone at the perfect time. The streaming service is home to a number of high-profile action series that have aided in making the streaming service a core locale for thrillers of all shapes and sizes. From the deadly serious stories presented in The Terminal List to the mystery-centered exploits of Cross , the streamer is home to all sorts of exciting stories filled to the brim with high-octane action.

 One of Prime Video's most influential franchises is Reacher , which recently finished out season 4 earlier this year. As Reacher season 5 goes into production, however, the show has expanded its horizons with a new spinoff series: Neagley . The companion series follows the titular Frances Neagley as she puts together a team to investigate the mysterious death of an old friend, and his ties to an isolated community. As the eight-episode search unfolds, Neagley becomes more engrossed in a wide-scale mystery involving an experimental drug that could change the world.
 Neagley Just Secured A Major Streaming Milestone
 Frances looking concerned in Neagley Via MovieStillsDB 
 Now, Neagley has secured a major streaming milestone after its debut on the platform in mid-September. According to data from November 10, 2026, Neagley has crossed 50 days on Prime Video's Top 10 in the United States. As of writing, the show is currently sitting at Number 5 in the United States, as well as Number 6 in the world. Despite having aired all episodes nearly two months ago, the Reacher spinoff is still going strong on streaming, attracting an audience weeks after its release.
 While the series owes some of its success to Reacher , it's also proven itself a strong action thriller on its own terms. According to Rotten Tomatoes, reviews for Neagley have scored it a Certified Fresh 94% on the website with critics, alongside an 82% from audiences. There's praise for the characters, writing, and action sequences, alongside a deeper look at the protagonist than audience got in the original show. It's also defined distinctly from its parent series, which helps make it all the more engaging.
 How Does The Action Series Leave The Door Open For Season 2?
 By October 2026, Neagley season 2 had been confirmed , the show scoring a swift renewal and confirming Prime Video's intention of making Reacher an ongoing franchise. It's unclear what will happen in season 2, but, in season 1, Neagley had built a team of characters who helped her uncover the truth about her friend's death. Following the conclusion of season 1's narrative, her and her team now run a detective agency, which can be the springboard for what season 2's plot is about.

 With the show having earned a strong score from critics and continuing to perform well both in the US and worldwide, it seems like Neagley is on track to continue being a massive success for Prime Video . The series has captured a global audience for an extended period of time, making the show a massive part of its lineup while also delivering plenty of exciting ideas that can carry it into the future.
